environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed via SAM with default execution role. Function URL enabled with AuthType NONE. Lambda runs in standard /var/task root with access to environment variables containing AWS credentials (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN). No additional runtime restrictions. The vm.Script sandbox can be escaped via prototype chain to access process object and read environment variables or execute child processes.
